note: Functional probes verify raster-service COMPUTES correctly, not merely that it is alive. Only the compute-only /v1/sar/rvi endpoint is declared: RVI = 4·VH/(VV+VH) on caller-supplied linear-power grids, so a probe run needs no S3/DB/Redis and no outbound CDSE or Element84 call (every tile, imagery and storage route is deliberately excluded — each one reaches an object store or an external provider). The endpoint is token-gated; the plan declares only the ${SAHOOL_AGENT_TOKEN} variable NAME (expanded at --run time), never a secret value. The expected values are derived by executing sar_rvi.compute_rvi directly, not by reading the formula: VV=0.7, VH=0.1 gives 4(0.1)/(0.7+0.1) = 0.5 exactly, strictly inside the [0,1] clip so a clipping regression cannot hide behind a saturated value. Producing evidence and setting runtime_verified is a separate, deliberate step; this plan alone changes nothing in the runtime ledger.
